notes.title: Turbo Dismount 2 Early Access Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Turbo Dismount 2 Early Access out now![/h1]

We are proud to announce that after over six years of development, Turbo Dismount 2 is now on Early Access!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2280350/Turbo_Dismount_2/]Turbo Dismount 2 on Steam[/url]

Join the community, all feedback is welcome as we build the finest tragicomic physics-driven survival puzzle racing sandbox ever created!

notes.title: Turbo Dismount 2 Coming Soon!
notes.content:
After [b]six years[/b] of development, we are ready to announce the glorious sequel!
[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2280350/]Wishlist now![/url] [/h2]

Feature highlights:
[list]
[*] Multiple characters on vehicles
[*] Multiple types of game goals
[*] Immensely capable level editing tools in Unity for your Steam Workshop delight
[*] Live face support with webcams!
[*] Animated bobblehead faces, with custom photo support!
[*] AAA-level driving physics
[*] Manual first-person driving
[*] A full visual upgrade from object detail to lighting to special effects
[*] An even more awesome replay system with new recording options
[*] An incomprehensibly slick sense of style oozing with confidence
[/list]

notes.title: Turbo Dismount 1.30 ”Golden Season” Update!
notes.content:
It’s the Season of Giving! So we give you...

* New obstacle: LOOT BOX!

Totally free, place any amount in any level!
Crash them open for free, painful, golden nuts and bolts!


DISCLAIMER: Nuts and bolts not usable as a currency or accessory in this corporate entertainment product. Loot box added for amusement purposes only. Nuts and bolts only appear as gold in the game, no real gold is explicitly or implicitly offered for simulation results. This game contains no collectibles. The developers of this corporate entertainment product have an underdeveloped sense of humor resulting in awkward situations and poorly communicated intentions. We apologize for the inconvenience and wish everyone happy holidays.

notes.title: Turbo Dismount v1.2 Update!
notes.content:
[b]New vehicles, new features, fixes and awesomeness galore![/b]

[list]
  [*]Full game controller support! Start the game with a controller attached to enable controller UI mode.
  [*]New vehicle: Heavy Metal - just the thing you need to get even!
  [*]New vehicle: The Swinger - if riding a wrecking ball is your preference!
  [*]Controller only: Replay scratching/scrubbing with analog triggers! The slow-mo replay is now so much better than before!

  [*]Level Editor Asset Package updated to include Nailed It! -condition
  [*]Level Editor documentation updated

  [*]Red flash in first person mode for cranial impacts
  [*]Additional props in some default levels
  [*]Much improved physics collision responses through more accurate relative element masses
  [*]Clear Obstacles -button added to level obstacle selection screen
  [*]Shadow quality improvements
  [*]Tweaked oil slick strength (stronger)

  [*]Bug fix: statistics tracking is fixed, helping with the unlocking of some achievements
  [*]Bug fix: exporting a level no longer causes an exception with parented elements
[/list]

EDIT: v1.2.1 update fixes the following:

[list]
  [*]Space bar again works for launching a dismount
  [*]Obstacle positions in Lane Merger fixed
[/list]

Let us know how it tastes on the forums!

notes.title: Turbo Dismount Update #8 - Usability & Performance Update!
notes.content:
[b]This update improves Turbo Dismount all over![/b] Better subscribing to Workshop levels, better performance, improved visuals, tweaked physics... it's a long list!

[b]Update #8.1:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Skid marks now recorded properly into replays
    [*]Achievement debug messages removed
    [*]Airtime icon improved
[/list]

[b]Update #8:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Mr. Dismount terminal velocity and rotation improved!
    [*]NPC vehicle collisions improved (proper mass / velocity inheritance - you'll see!)
    [*]Much improved Workshop level browsing and subscription experience!
    [*]Quality selector! Hold down alt-key when starting the game to bring out the quality selection screen!
    [*]Space Program now brings Glory to Arstotzka! - Huge congrats to Papers, Please for well-deserved IGF victories! We tip our hats!
    [*]Nuts, bolts and springs now fly around in collisions
    [*]Bobblehead photo now properly looks at the camera in replay mode
    [*]OSX version now properly starts in the foreground
    [*]Unvisited and unused levels and items now have an indicator icon
    [*]How did we now have this before? SKID MARKS! Of course! (Not visible in replays yet.)
    [*]Impact sounds improved with a little more punch
    [*]Airtime noted with an icon and score bonuses
    [*]Also plenty of under-the-hood improvements to performance and memory management
[/list]


--- Update history ---

[b]Update 7:[/b]
You can now create traffic in your levels!

- NPC Vehicles can be spawned! Create pile-ups of your dreams!
- Performance improvements and fixes
- Longer level timeouts for Workshop levels
- Level Editing Guide updated
- New example levels in the level editing tools package

[b]Update 6:[/b]
[b]You can now create new levels and share them over Steam Workshop! Read the Level Editing Guide and make metal moan![/b]

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=229436864

Other stuff:
[list]
[*]Subscribe to Workshop levels in the Workshop! Play your subscribed levels by pressing the "Browse Workshop levels" button in the level selection screen!
[*]Scoring tweaked! We now have a damage multiplier for quick consecutive impacts!
[*]Free Cam added! See the crashes from any angle with WASD+LMB! (And Q, E, ctrl and shift)
[*]Hide the on-screen HUD with ctrl-h for perfect video captures!
[*]Hotspots and vehicle spots now have a direction indicator
[*]Physics have been tweaked for improved stability (particularly when you pile stuff in the editor...)
[*]Road cone obstacle placement fixed
[*]New objects to place in the editor: steel beam, bush
